title: Final Radial Equation
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly derive and present the final equation for radial displacement r.

title: Final Angular Equation
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly derive and present the final equation for angular displacement theta.

title: Lagrangian Formulation
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly formulate the Lagrangian L using kinetic and potential energy expressions.

title: Equations of Motion
description: Important Criteria: The student must derive the correct equations of motion using Lagrange's equations.

title: Equilibrium Position
description: Important Criteria: The student must identify and derive the equilibrium position in terms of r0 and theta0.

title: Small Angle Approximation
description: Optional Criteria: The student should apply the small angle approximation correctly in the equations of motion.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should ensure that all terms in the equations have consistent units.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid common errors such as sign mistakes in the equations of motion.

title: Missing Factors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should not omit any necessary factors in the potential energy expression.
